name: Apathy - Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi - Himitsu
original_name: アパシー学校であった怖い話 秘密
source:
Project celebrating the 25th anniversary of [url=/v745]Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi[/url].
The choices were chosen based on Twitter's polls and a contest was held to find new branching scenarios. As a result, each branching route was written by a fan of the series.

This version of Himitsu is much bigger and has many more choices than the one included in [url=https://vndb.org/v34196]Narunana[/url].
translation:
为庆祝[url=/v745]《学校发生过的恐怖故事》[/url]25周年而推出的企划。
选项通过Twitter投票决定，同时举办了征集新分支剧情的比赛。因此，每条分支路线都由系列粉丝执笔。

这个版本的《秘密》，比[url=https://vndb.org/v34196]《鸣神学园七大不可思议》[/url]所收录的版本篇幅更大，选项也多得多。
